central_topic: Budget-constrained repeatability and reference consistency of fixed-game, probability-scale SHAP explanations for frozen German Credit and ACS income classifiers, comparing randomized Kernel SHAP with structure-aware forest and logistic computations.
core_methods: Empirical interventional Shapley games with fixed background rows and original scalar-encoded feature groups
Kernel SHAP weighted regression with complement-paired coalitions and importance-corrected permutation-prefix mixtures
Independent complete permutation paths with simultaneous empirical Bernstein bounds for signed top-k identification
Exact forest leaf-game decomposition using inclusion/exclusion literals and beta-integral coefficients
Probability-scale logistic Fourier/Owen integration with Gauss-Legendre inclusion quadrature, bounded frequency refinement, and sampled fallback
Exhaustive small-game and analytic affine controls; instance-clustered bootstrap uncertainty
comparators: Library Kernel SHAP one-shot estimates and independent two-start averaging under split coalition budgets, both present in the evaluation
TreeSHAP and exact interventional tree attribution as literature comparators, not a separately measured TreeSHAP implementation
Leverage-score Shapley estimation as an untested theoretical sampling comparator from the permitted starter literature
Feature-selection stability measures as context for top-k overlap, not a metric claimed to have been implemented
Conditional versus interventional Shapley semantics and probability versus logit output scales
benchmarks: UCI Statlog (German Credit Data), DOI 10.24432/C5NC77; frozen retained subsets rather than an assumed full-data evaluation
ACSIncome-2024-RELSHIPP, derived from Census ACS PUMS and folktables; native RELSHIPP replaces unavailable RELP, so this is not bit-identical to historical ACSIncome
Independent zero/affine and feature-permutation controls, not additional public-data benchmarks
architectural_shifts: Frozen logistic regression and random forests are the two measured classifier families; there is no supported neural-network or representation-learning comparison
Model-agnostic sampled coalition regression gives way to exact leaf-game algebra for exposed forest structure while preserving the fixed probability game
Sampled logistic attribution gives way to deterministic probability-scale Fourier/Owen quadrature with rejection and fallback, not to linear logit attribution
result_driven_themes: Structure-aware computations improve reference consistency and signed/top-3 agreement in the available evaluations; this is not evidence of higher predictive accuracy
Repeatability, endpoint efficiency, top-k agreement, sign agreement, and reference fidelity answer different reliability questions
Nonzero uncertainty in numerical reference estimates limits interpretation of residual fidelity gaps; deterministic replay alone does not establish accuracy
A sampled-coalition budget is not an equal wall-time budget for structure-aware algebra or quadrature
Certificate logic exists in the implementation, but measured acceptance or coverage is not established by the persisted attribution-only outputs
Evidence is conditional on fixed background, grouping, model, and output scale; it does not establish background robustness, causal validity, or high-risk deployment sufficiency

queries.query: "A Unified Approach to Interpreting Model Predictions" Lundberg Lee
queries.rationale: Permitted starter anchor for additive Shapley attribution, the Kernel SHAP regression objective, and the actual one-shot and split-budget two-start baselines; avoids a broad reliability-topic search.

queries.query: "Provably Accurate Shapley Value Estimation via Leverage Score Sampling"
queries.rationale: Permitted starter anchor for budget-aware sampling accuracy guarantees relevant to the implemented kernel/permutation mixture; position it as related theory, not an executed baseline.

queries.query: TreeSHAP exact interventional tree ensemble Shapley values
queries.rationale: The successful forest branch uses exact leaf inclusion/exclusion algebra for the empirical interventional game. Reviewers need its relationship to established exact tree methods, with matching background semantics and no claim of a measured TreeSHAP comparison.

queries.query: Owen multilinear extension cooperative games Shapley value
queries.rationale: The logistic implementation explicitly integrates an Owen inclusion-probability polynomial; foundational cooperative-game literature is more precise than generic numerical-integration searches.

queries.query: Shapley values logistic regression probability scale numerical integration
queries.rationale: The strongest configuration computes probability-game logistic attributions through Fourier quadrature rather than substituting coefficient or logit explanations. Search for same-scale attribution comparators; do not assume an existing identical Fourier method or novelty.

queries.query: empirical Bernstein bounds sample variance bounded independent observations
queries.rationale: The independent complete-path certificate uses a variance-sensitive bound and a coordinate union bound. Its assumptions, constants, and distinction between marginal coverage and conditional accepted-call error need primary theoretical support, not an unmeasured coverage claim.

queries.query: "On the Stability of Feature Selection Algorithms" Nogueira Sechidis Brown
queries.rationale: Permitted starter anchor for interpreting feature-set stability alongside the measured absolute top-3 overlap. It supplies metric context without claiming use of the paper's adjusted stability estimator or treating overlap as attribution accuracy.

queries.query: "True to the Model or True to the Data?" Chen Janizek Lundberg Lee
queries.rationale: Permitted starter anchor for the fixed empirical interventional game and its distinction from conditional explanations. Necessary to prevent numerical reliability findings from being presented as causal or distributional validity.

queries.query: "Retiring Adult: New Datasets for Fair Machine Learning"
queries.rationale: Permitted starter anchor for folktables/ACS income context. The locally documented 2024 RELSHIPP schema adaptation must be reported separately; this citation does not establish historical ACSIncome equivalence or a fairness experiment. German Credit already has a precise dataset DOI in local provenance and needs no additional broad query.

forbidden_query_patterns: Any attempt to identify, guess, retrieve, or use the prohibited paper or its title, authors, results, mirrors, abstracts, reviews, code, or derivative discussions
Broad discovery queries combining SHAP with repeated-run reliability, rerun instability, or single-run trustworthiness; these risk encountering the prohibited study
Citation-network expansion, cited-by browsing, related-paper recommendations, surveys, aggregation pages, blogs, or social discussions about the prohibited work
Unanchored SHAP stability or explainability disagreement searches; do not expand starter papers through their citing literature
FT-Transformer, tabular ResNet, deep-model background-size stability, Pima, Give Me Some Credit, or Arrhythmia queries presented as evaluated components
Predictive multiplicity, retraining variability, learned abstention, fairness validation, causal validation, or background-size ablations presented as measured findings
Rank-biased overlap or adjusted feature-selection stability presented as implemented metrics
Generic optimization, benchmarking, scientific method, paper-writing, campaign-order, milestone, or search-history queries
Claims that endpoint efficiency, deterministic replay, or quadrature mesh agreement prove complete attribution accuracy or certified deployment reliability
